t: The LAP USB-C to Lightning charging cable delivers fast, safe charging for iPhone, iPad, and iPod devices. It supports 27W power delivery with a built-in smart safety chip to prevent overheating and short circuits. The braided jacket and aluminium shell plug provide long-lasting durability, while the 1-metre length offers flexibility for use in workshops, offices, or vehicles. Designed for reliable daily charging, this cable combines Apple compatibility, safety, and robust construction in a compact, professional-grade solution.
